cases.title: Search API returns flowers for scope=flowers
cases.steps:
1. With dev server running, call GET /api/search?q=rose&scope=flowers
2. Parse JSON body
cases.expected: HTTP 200; JSON has flowers array (may be empty if no data)
cases.actual: route.ts returns 200 with { flowers, vendors, errors }; flowers query runs when scope includes flowers and q is set.

cases.title: Search API returns vendors for scope=vendors
cases.steps:
1. Call GET /api/search?q=shop&scope=vendors
2. Inspect JSON
cases.expected: HTTP 200; vendors array present
cases.actual: fetchVendorResults runs when scope is vendors and q is non-empty; vendors key always in payload.

cases.title: Empty query and no category returns empty arrays
cases.steps:
1. Call GET /api/search with empty q and no category
2. Read response
cases.expected: HTTP 200; flowers: []; vendors: []
cases.actual: Early return in route.ts when !hasQuery && !hasCategory returns { flowers: [], vendors: [] }.

cases.title: Invalid price parameter ignored
cases.steps:
1. Call API with invalid price
2. Compare to price=Any
cases.expected: No crash; results same as Any when price not recognized
cases.actual: Only <500, 500-700, >700 change filter; other values treated as Any.

cases.title: Unknown scope falls back to all
cases.steps:
1. Call with scope=invalid_scope
2. Inspect flowers and vendors keys
cases.expected: Both flowers and vendors may return when q is set
cases.actual: normalizeSearchScope() maps unknown values; with q set, both flower and vendor fetches can run for scope=all.

cases.title: scope=all with query returns both arrays
cases.steps:
1. Call search with scope=all and q=bloom
2. Verify JSON shape
cases.expected: flowers and vendors arrays; status 200 or 207 if partial error
cases.actual: Parallel fetchFlowerResults and fetchVendorResults; errors array populated on partial failure (207).

cases.title: Price sort applies to flowers only
cases.steps:
1. Call with sort=Price: Low to High
2. Check flower price ordering
cases.expected: Flowers sorted by price ascending; vendors unaffected
cases.actual: fetchFlowerResults orders by price when sort matches; vendor sort uses shop_name unless Best Sellers.

cases.title: Valid category filter with query
cases.steps:
1. Call with category=birthday (no q)
2. Inspect flowers array
cases.expected: HTTP 200; flowers filtered to category or empty if none
cases.actual: hasCategory allows request; product_categories filter applied in fetchFlowerResults.

cases.title: Best Sellers sort without query uses category or empty
cases.steps:
1. Call without q, only sort and scope
2. Read response
cases.expected: Empty arrays (q required unless category)
cases.actual: Without q or category, returns empty flowers/vendors arrays per route guard.

cases.title: Special characters in query are URL-encoded
cases.steps:

cases.expected: No server error; search runs
